generic_orbit_completeness: A counterexample has at least eleven silent directions. After normalizing three, at least eight silent directions remain. The exceptional harmonic and equianharmonic anharmonic orbits contain only 3+2=5 directions, so one remaining direction lies in a generic orbit represented by 3,4,5, or 12.
cycle_hash_reduction: Direction-0 silence gives even fibre degrees. Choose two selected points from one fibre and remove them. The row-even eight-point complement has one of the even degree types from the weight-eight replay and therefore splits into two row-even four-point halves. Fixed-four silence is exactly sig(A) xor sig(B)=sig(C), where C is the removed same-fibre pair and the signature records the sixteen fibres in directions 1,31,lambda.
scalar_normalization: The order-15 scalar group F_31^*/{+-1} fixes every projective direction and acts freely on unordered distinct same-fibre pairs: an odd-order stabilizer cannot swap the two points, and pointwise stabilization is the identity. Its action partitions all 7,080 same-fibre pairs into exactly 472 orbits. One actual coordinate pair representative from every orbit was checked.
duplicate_handling: The hash maps each distinct four-half signature to its full sorted-record group; every matching signature relation expands the complete Cartesian product of duplicate groups before point-disjointness checks.
independent_replay: scripts.p31_group_branch_cms.verify reconstructed every displayed support with weight ten, the displayed ten silent directions, active_direction_count=22, group_branch_weight=32, and counterexample=false
scope: Exact closure only of the p=31 grouped-uncertainty decision problem at point weight ten; not the full grouped inequality, row-code distance, residual (ii), E1, or the original MO limit.
